notes: Arce for Mac is moving to Chromium, the same engine as Chrome. This update gets your Mac ready: it keeps your passwords and sign-ins safe for the switch. The Chromium version for Mac is attached as a test download (Arce-Chromium-Mac.zip). Windows and Linux: small fixes.
